object_description: two complementary building volumes around differentiated outdoor spaces
design_condition: Two new volumes are precisely arranged around the existing complex, with differentiated entrances and outdoor spaces mediating between the school and gymnasium while placing the main break area across the street.

positive.statement: The precise arrangement of the two new buildings creates a sequence of clearly assigned outdoor spaces.
The differentiated entrances take account of the address formation of the individual uses.
The volumetric pivot mediates between the existing school complex and the new gymnasium building.
The access system cleverly separates the uses and connects them again via a second staircase and the elevator.
The ground-level arrangement and visual reference to the outside space are welcomed.
The multi-purpose building impresses from a functional point of view, with a spacious foyer transitioning to the ground-level hall and viewing the outside space.
Delivery is well organized at the rear of the facility.
The reserved appearance relates to the existing building and creates a unified whole.
The buildings are simply structured and are expected to provide good profitability.

negative.statement: The break area being mainly on the other side of the street is viewed critically.
The kindergarten outdoor area seems somewhat tight, and information about its use and design is almost completely missing.
The access halls lack a connection to the outside and are not very suitable as learning zones.
The front glazing significantly impairs sports operations in the gymnasium.
The great depth of the school building could not be managed convincingly.
Defects in the lighting of the kindergartens and corridors and the introverted break halls are evidence of this.
